title: 道岔可動心軌控制~Movable-point frog control
focus: 可動心軌位置鎖閉與回讀一致性~Movable frog position locking and feedback consistency
summary: 道岔可動心軌控制以「可動心軌位置鎖閉與回讀一致性」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。可動心軌在不同路徑下提供連續輪面支承，位置、機械鎖閉與電氣表示是三種獨立證據；命令發出並不等於路徑已可使用。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops movable frog position locking and feedback consistency through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A movable frog provides continuous running support for different routes; position, mechanical locking and electrical indication are separate evidence, and issuing a command does not establish route availability. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把道岔可動心軌控制放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。可動心軌在不同路徑下提供連續輪面支承，位置、機械鎖閉與電氣表示是三種獨立證據；命令發出並不等於路徑已可使用。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Movable-point frog control in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. A movable frog provides continuous running support for different routes; position, mechanical locking and electrical indication are separate evidence, and issuing a command does not establish route availability. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：travel=80 mm, time=4 s；y=travel/time=20 mm/s。只把 travel 增加百分之十，y=22 mm/s。模型邊界：位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：timeout=8 s, move=4 s, prove=1 s；y=timeout-move-prove=3 s。只把 timeout 增加百分之十，y=3.8 s。模型邊界：移動與證明階段依序且不重疊；超時預算是教學假設；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: travel=80 mm, time=4 s; y=travel/time=20 mm/s. Increasing only travel with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 mm/s. Boundary: Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: timeout=8 s, move=4 s, prove=1 s; y=timeout-move-prove=3 s. Increasing only timeout with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.8 s. Boundary: Movement and proving stages are sequential without overlap; timeout budget is a teaching assumption; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 心軌平均行程速度~Mean frog travel speed
units.title: 心軌平均行程速度~Mean frog travel speed
units.mechanism: 平均速度不描述起動和鎖閉區的局部速度。本模型把 travel 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 mm/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻。使用全行程位置時間曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Mean speed does not describe local speed during starting and locking. In this model, travel is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 22 mm/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed. Use full-stroke position-time trace as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：travel=80 mm, time=4 s；y=travel/time=20 mm/s。只把 travel 增加百分之十，y=22 mm/s。模型邊界：位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: travel=80 mm, time=4 s; y=travel/time=20 mm/s. Increasing only travel with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 mm/s. Boundary: Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以全行程位置時間曲線區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型連續位置、共同時鐘及末端停滯時間建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「心軌平均行程速度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use full-stroke position-time trace to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using continuous low-voltage model position, common clock and endpoint dwell time, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Mean frog travel speed. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻。這個失效與「心軌平均行程速度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查全行程位置時間曲線，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding. This failure and a measurement bias in Mean frog travel speed can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check full-stroke position-time trace rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding.
units.practice: 重算「心軌平均行程速度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻造成偏離的合成觀察，以全行程位置時間曲線說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Mean frog travel speed, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding. Explain which evidence in full-stroke position-time trace distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 鎖閉時間餘量~Locking time reserve
units.title: 鎖閉時間餘量~Locking time reserve
units.mechanism: 移動和證明時間共同消耗超時預算。本模型把 timeout 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.8 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。移動與證明階段依序且不重疊；超時預算是教學假設。使用命令位置鎖閉的時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只監測馬達停止會漏掉未鎖閉狀態，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Movement and proving time consume one timeout budget. In this model, timeout is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.8 s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Movement and proving stages are sequential without overlap; timeout budget is a teaching assumption. units.anchor: 感測器分辨率~Position sensor resolution
units.title: 感測器分辨率~Position sensor resolution
units.mechanism: 數位分辨率不是絕對位置精度。本模型把 stroke 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.0268555 mm/count。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。完整行程均勻分配至計數格；不含校準誤差及間隙。使用基準尺與編碼器對照作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高位元數可能掩蓋機械間隙，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Digital resolution is not absolute position accuracy. In this model, stroke is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.0268555 mm/count. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Full stroke is uniformly divided into count bins; calibration error and backlash are excluded. Use reference gauge versus encoder reading as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. High bit depth can conceal mechanical backlash; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：stroke=100 mm, counts=4096 count；y=stroke/counts=0.0244141 mm/count。只把 stroke 增加百分之十，y=0.0268555 mm/count。模型邊界：完整行程均勻分配至計數格；不含校準誤差及間隙；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: stroke=100 mm, counts=4096 count; y=stroke/counts=0.0244141 mm/count. Increasing only stroke with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.0268555 mm/count. Boundary: Full stroke is uniformly divided into count bins; calibration error and backlash are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以基準尺與編碼器對照區分模型與觀察，先用模型基準尺、編碼器碼值及正反行程回差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「感測器分辨率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use reference gauge versus encoder reading to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.title: 推力量級估算~Actuation-force scale
units.mechanism: 固定機械速度下可用推力受功率及效率限制。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2750 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。功率與效率固定、速度非零且穩態；不適用堵轉。使用低載模型推力及速度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；以堵轉電流直接推定有效推力可能失準，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Available force at fixed speed depends on power and efficiency. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2750 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Power and efficiency are constant at nonzero steady speed; stall is excluded. Use low-load model force and speed as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Stall current alone can misrepresent useful force; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=100 W, eta=0.5 1, v=0.02 m/s；y=P*eta/v=2500 N。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=2750 N。模型邊界：功率與效率固定、速度非零且穩態；不適用堵轉；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=100 W, eta=0.5 1, v=0.02 m/s; y=P*eta/v=2500 N. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=2750 N. Boundary: Power and efficiency are constant at nonzero steady speed; stall is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以低載模型推力及速度區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型同步電功率、機械速度與推力建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「推力量級估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use low-load model force and speed to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synchronous low-load model electrical power, mechanical speed and force, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Actuation-force scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

This failure and a measurement bias in Actuation-force scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check low-load model force and speed rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. units.failure: 共享電源故障會讓乘積估計過度樂觀。這個失效與「獨立漏檢乘積」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查人工注入故障與獨立性證據，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Shared supply failure makes the product estimate optimistic. units.anchor: 回讀掃描間距~Feedback scan interval
units.title: 回讀掃描間距~Feedback scan interval
units.mechanism: 掃描週期是延遲的一部分而非全部。本模型把 fs 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 18.1818 ms。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。固定週期且無遺失掃描；不是端到端最壞反應時間。使用輸入輸出共同時鐘紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略通訊與排程延遲會低估反應時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Scan period is only one part of latency. In this model, fs is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 18.1818 ms. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed period without missed scans; not worst-case end-to-end response time. Use input-output records on one clock as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring communication and scheduling understates response time; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：fs=50 Hz；y=1/fs*1000=20 ms。只把 fs 增加百分之十，y=18.1818 ms。模型邊界：固定週期且無遺失掃描；不是端到端最壞反應時間；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: fs=50 Hz; y=1/fs*1000=20 ms. Increasing only fs with a ten-percent increase gives y=18.1818 ms. Boundary: Fixed period without missed scans; not worst-case end-to-end response time; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
